page.notes: Running head and page number are read at small size; "118" is the most likely reading. The catchword is read as "sionem" from a worn letter, so it is doubtful. The italic passage has no clear paragraph indents, so it is kept as one paragraph. The opening of the numbered paragraph is in heavier type, which the markup does not show. The printed "Gerson" is spelled as in the print, with "Gersom" not used. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
